subject: FastCart - final top-up request to close
content:
From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@fastcart.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fastcart.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FastCart - last-week request for trial top-up to finalize POC

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked how Redwood handled low-latency reranking. We’re 95% there internally but have one blocker: the pilot token runway. Our CTO wants one final internal check before sign-off, and Procurement has requested an extended trial/one-time credit to exercise integration under production-like load.

Can Redwood provide a one-time token top-up (~50k tokens) or $3k credit tied to a signed MSA within 7 days? If we can get that in place and a short procurement checklist completed, we’ll move to a 12-month committed plan.

I can share a short Mutual Action Plan and procurement contact if that helps. Appreciate a quick yes/no so I can set expectations.

Cheers,
Tara
Tara Singh
Head of Partnerships, FastCart
(t) 415-555-0198

---

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@fastcart.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FastCart - last-week request for trial top-up to finalize POC

Tara —

Thanks for the clear ask. I’ll loop in Ben and Marissa to scope the right offer and get finance sign-off. We typically do a trial top-up tied to a Mutual Action Plan and a DocuSign intent (MSA + SOW), but I don’t expect a problem for a one-time incentive to close.

Quick ask: can you drop the procurement contact and the expected production sequence so we can tie success metrics to the credit?

I’ll respond with a formal offer by EOD.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastCart - last-week request for trial top-up to finalize POC

Team —

Quick read: customer asks for ~50k tokens or $3k equivalent, conditional on signing MSA within 7 days. FastCart looks high-probability; they’ve been running steady queries and traffic pattern looks similar to SMB checkout flows. I’d push for a $3k top-up that maps to 50k tokens and tie to a 12-mo commit at our Std Growth tier to convert.

Notes on approvals: discounts/credits > $2k need finance OK (Rishi). Anything > $5k needs Director sign-off (Marissa). Since this is $3k — finance route only. We should also capture obligations in the MAP.

Proposed language for customer:
- One-time $3,000 Redwood credit applied to first invoice upon MSA signature within 7 calendar days.
- Credit expires 60 days after MSA signature if not consumed.
- MAP to include two success tests: 1) 1M tokens processed in pilot week; 2) acceptable P95 latency under 350ms.

I can draft the DocuSign and MAP if you want me to.

Ben
Account Executive

---

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastCart - last-week request for trial top-up to finalize POC

Ben / Lauren —

Finance is OK with a one-time $3,000 credit under these conditions:
1) We attach the credit to deal FC-202706-045 in HubSpot.
2) Customer signs a non-recoupable intent (DocuSign) for a 12-month commitment at the Growth tier or higher.
3) Credit is paid as a line-item adjustment on the first invoice after the MSA executes.

I’ll need a completed credit_approval_form_v2.docx routed through me for records. Once I receive that form with the HubSpot link and the MAP attached, I’ll counter-sign within the day.

Rishi
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

---

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@fastcart.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastCart - last-week request for trial top-up to finalize POC

Tara —

Great — we can do a one-time $3,000 Redwood credit applied to the first invoice, conditional on FastCart signing a 12-month MSA (Growth tier) within 7 days. I’ve attached the MAP and the credit approval form for your procurement team to review. Please send me the procurement contact and I’ll initiate DocuSign.

Attached: FastCart_MutualActionPlan.pdf; credit_approval_form_v2.docx

Looking forward to closing this out quickly.

Warmly,
Lauren

Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 10:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FastCart - last-week request for trial top-up to finalize POC

Lauren —

Thanks — CC’ing our procurement lead, Miguel Reyes (miguel.reyes@fastcart.com). We reviewed the MAP; the success criteria are fine. Miguel, can you review the credit form and confirm we’ll return a signed MSA by next Thursday? If procurement needs tweaks, Miguel will flag them and we can loop ASAP.

Appreciate the quick turnaround from Redwood — I’ll push internally to meet the 7-day window.

Best,
Tara
